dedupe_keys.name: pantamera deposit return statistics sweden return rates for cans and pet bottles packages sold and returned recycled aluminium and pet tonnage municipal statistics portal

description: Pantamera is the brand of Sweden's deposit return system for beverage cans and PET bottles, and its statistics page reports each year how many containers are returned and recycled. The page read on 2026-09-28 gives the national goal of 90% return, supervised by the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency, and the 2025 results: return rates of 88.8% for cans, 87.5% for PET bottles and 88.4% overall, 3.39 billion containers sold and 3.00 billion returned, 283 containers per person, and recycled material of 27,826 tonnes of aluminium, 23,328 tonnes of clear PET and 1,507 tonnes of coloured PET. A linked statistics portal shows returns by part of the country and by municipality and their development over time. Coverage is Sweden. Access is free; no licence is stated, and the portal's export options were not read. Caveats: figures are compiled by the system operator, and the page itself carries only the current year. It supports waste service capacity studies, such as sizing collection and reverse logistics for returned containers by municipality. Related record: the Ecoembes packaging waste data for Spain.
